responseText:
You look like you could use a transport. Usually, the 'Laws of Verra' prevent us from using Lightpact portals for short distance teleportation, but (thanks to Vyra) a temporary exception has been made for this season's PTR testers. Since you are one of our privileged playtesters, I can transport you to one of the new and exciting pocket dungeons found in the Anvils. 

If you know where you would like to go, please make your choice now.

Have a safe and pleasant journey! And thank you, for choosing Lightpact Gateways for your travels today.
name: General_Test_ANV_Dungeon_Teleporter_DLG_2_Response
